alt.en: A gray plate holds a phone at the front left, a flat gray server, a tall light-indigo box in the center and an indigo padlock on the right. A dashed orange line with packets runs from the phone to the server and on into the box; a dotted indigo line runs from the padlock to the box.
alt.zh: 灰色底板上，左前方立着一部手机，旁边是一台扁平的灰色服务器，中央是一个高大的浅靛蓝色方块，右侧是一把靛蓝色挂锁。带数据包的橙色虚线从手机经服务器通往方块，靛蓝色点线从挂锁连到方块。

caption.en: Illustration: a request travels from a user's app through an ingress server into a per-session microVM, which a token check also guards, as in the design AWS describes for AgentCore Runtime. It does not depict a tested deployment or AWS's systems, and it does not show that the controls work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：按照 AWS 为 AgentCore Runtime 描述的设计，请求从用户应用经接入服务器进入按会话启动的 microVM，令牌检查同样把守这一入口。图中并非经过测试的部署，也不代表 AWS 的系统，不表明这些控制措施如所述那样有效。
